name: nezolder-civil3d-mcp
description: Civil 3D Roslyn MCP connector (civil3d_query, civil3d_execute, civil3d_skills). Starts the MCP server installed on this PC; contains no skills.

interface.shortDescription: Drive Autodesk Civil 3D 2025 with C# scripts
interface.longDescription: Starts the Civil 3D Roslyn MCP server installed on this PC (npm run install:server) and gives Codex its three tools: civil3d_query, civil3d_execute and civil3d_skills. Contains no skills; the server hands over its own working order.
